For help with Alexandria Reader, email
[tyler.kirby9398@gmail.com](mailto:tyler.kirby9398@gmail.com).

Please include your device model, iOS or iPadOS version, Alexandria version
(shown in Settings), and what you were doing when the problem occurred. For a
text or dictionary issue, include the author, work, passage, and word involved.
Screenshots can help, but remove any personal information you do not want to share.

Flagging a word inside the app saves it for review; it does not automatically
send a support request. You can export flagged words and attach the file to an
email if you want the developer to investigate them.

If your reading data is not syncing, check Alexandria's iCloud setting and
whether the app reports a sync problem. Restart after changing the sync setting.
Contact support before deleting data or resetting the app to troubleshoot sync.

Read the [privacy policy](https://jtylerkirby.com/alexandria/privacy.html) for
details about local storage, iCloud, and information you choose to share.
